## What this is

Single-page marketing landing page for Baby Dog, a 24h veterinary center in
Jundiaí/SP. Built by the agency Neotec. Not yet public — see
`CONTEUDO-PENDENTE.md` for the go-live checklist and every piece of content
still waiting on the clinic.

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev      # dev server on :3000
npm run build    # production build — ALSO the only type-check (no separate tsc/typecheck script)
npm run start    # serve the production build
npm run lint     # ESLint (flat config in eslint.config.mjs; scripts/** is ignored)
```

There is no test suite.

**Asset generation** (`scripts/*.js`) is run by hand, never as part of the
build. The scripts are CJS, ESLint-ignored, and read raw source assets from
`../imagens clinica babydog/` — a folder *outside* this repo, a sibling of it.
They write optimized files into `public/`.
- `gen-estrutura.js`, `gen-marca.js`, `gen-icons.js` — need `sharp` (present as
  a Next.js optional dependency, not in `package.json`).
- `gen-hero-mobile-poster.js` — needs `ffmpeg` on `PATH`.

## Architecture

**`lib/content.ts` is the single source of truth for all copy and business
data** — phones, address, hours, section headings, testimonials, and the
action-link builders (`linkWhatsApp`, `linkGoogleMaps`, `linkWaze`,
`embedMapa`). Nothing user-facing is hardcoded in components. To change text,
a phone number, or a testimonial, edit `content.ts` and nothing else.

`app/page.tsx` is an async Server Component that composes the sections in
journey order (deliberately different from the nav order in `content.ts` —
see the comment there and git history). One section = one file in
`components/`. Section anchor IDs (`#a-clinica`, `#atendimentos`, `#contato`,
…) live on the `<section>` elements and are referenced by `navegacao`;
`scroll-mt-24` / `scroll-padding-top` offset the fixed header.

Server Components by default. `"use client"` only in: Carrossel, Contato, CTA,
Depoimentos, Footer, Header, HeroVideoFundo, Localizacao, WhatsAppFlutuante.
Hooks in `lib/` (`use-media-query`, `use-reduced-motion`, `use-scroll-passed`)
are all SSR-safe via `useSyncExternalStore`, assuming `false` on the server.

Path alias `@/*` → repo root (`@/components/...`, `@/lib/...`, `@/public/...`).

### Publish gates (`clinica` in content.ts)

- `clinica.indexavel` — `false` today. While false, `app/robots.ts` blocks all
  crawlers and `app/layout.tsx` emits `noindex`. `app/sitemap.ts`, canonical,
  OpenGraph and JSON-LD all derive from `clinica.site`.
- `clinica.exibirDadosLegais` — gates the CNPJ / razão social line in the
  footer (off until the clinic confirms the current legal entity).
- Going live = set `clinica.site` to the final domain, `indexavel: true`,
  redeploy. Details in `CONTEUDO-PENDENTE.md`.

### Google reviews (social proof)

`lib/avaliacoes-google.ts` runs server-side, called from `page.tsx`. It hits
the Google Places API (Details) using **server-only** env vars
`GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY` / `GOOGLE_PLACES_ID` (never `NEXT_PUBLIC_`), cached 1h.
Returns `null` on missing keys or any failure; `components/Depoimentos.tsx`
then falls back to the static `avaliacao` / `depoimentos` in `content.ts`.
Live data wins over static when present. With neither live nor static content,
the section renders nothing — by design.

### Contact form

`components/Contato.tsx` (`"use client"`): the guaranteed channel is WhatsApp.
On submit it **synchronously** `window.open`s a `wa.me` link with a prefilled
message (must stay inside the click handler or the browser blocks the popup),
then fires a best-effort `POST /api/contato` in the background that is never
awaited. Client-side validation limits deliberately mirror the server's.
Honeypot field is named `website`.

`app/api/contato/route.ts` optionally forwards the lead to `CONTACT_WEBHOOK_URL`
(n8n/Make/Zapier) or Resend (`RESEND_API_KEY` + `CONTACT_EMAIL`). With neither
configured it returns 503, which is harmless since the client ignores the
response.

### Analytics

`lib/track.ts` — `rastrear(evento, detalhes)` pushes to `dataLayer` / `gtag` /
`fbq` if they exist, no-ops otherwise. `components/Analytics.tsx` injects the
GTM / GA4 / Meta Pixel `<script>` tags **only** when the matching
`NEXT_PUBLIC_*_ID` env var is set — no third-party script loads until an ID
exists. The conversion events (`clique_whatsapp`, `clique_telefone`,
`envio_formulario`) map to a Meta "Lead".

### Styling

Tailwind CSS v4, configured in CSS via `@theme` in `app/globals.css` — there is
no `tailwind.config.js`. Brand color tokens carry documented WCAG contrast
ratios in that file; `accent` (#28aa9e) is decorative only and must never be
used for text (use `accent-dark`). Fonts are self-hosted via `next/font`
(Poppins for body, Oswald as `font-oswald` for select headings) — no request
to an external font host.

## Domain rules — apply to any new copy

- **CRMV compliance**: Brazilian veterinary advertising may not mention price,
  discount, promotion, commercial terms, installments, guaranteed
  results/cure, or comparison with competitors. Tone stays technical and
  welcoming, never sensational.
- **Never invent** testimonials, ratings, numbers, or specialties. The static
  rating in `content.ts` was verified against the clinic's real Google profile;
  the empty testimonials array hides its section on purpose.
- Reviewer names/text may only be shown when they come from the Places API
  (Google's terms allow re-displaying API results; scraping Maps is not
  allowed — and isn't possible anyway, the page is JS-rendered).
